stories.title: Implement server-side blog post auto-discovery from /site/src/blog/posts directory
stories.description: Create a blog-loader utility that scans for TypeScript blog post files, validates them against a BlogPostMeta schema, and exposes them via a getBlogPosts() function for use in blog listing, sitemap generation, and RSS feed creation. This is core infrastructure for the static blog system.
acceptanceCriteria: getBlogPosts() returns sorted array of valid blog posts with title, slug, date, author, excerpt, and category fields
Invalid posts (missing required fields) are logged as warnings but don't crash the loader; validation uses Zod schema
Posts are cached during build time; calling revalidateTag('blog-posts') clears cache and refreshes on next request
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/lib/blog-loader.ts (implement getBlogPosts with fs.readdirSync, dynamic imports, Zod validation)
File to edit: site/src/types/blog.ts (add BlogPostMeta interface with all required fields)
Test command: npm run test -- blog-loader.test.ts (test valid/invalid post loading, caching, sorting)

stories.title: Create Article JSON-LD schema generator for blog post structured data
stories.description: Build generateArticleSchema() utility that creates proper Article schema.org markup from blog post metadata, including author, datePublished, dateModified, wordCount, and image. Integrate into blog [slug]/page.tsx metadata export to enable rich snippets in search results.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema includes @context: 'https://schema.org', @type: 'BlogPosting', headline, datePublished, dateModified, author.name, wordCount, and image URL
dateModified is optional and defaults to datePublished if not provided in post metadata
Generated schema validates against schema.org validator; unit tests confirm @id and URL fields are absolute URLs

File to edit: site/src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx (call generateArticleSchema in metadata export for structured data)

stories.title: Add blog post reading time calculator utility with unit tests
stories.description: Create calculateReadingTime() function that estimates reading duration from markdown content (200 words/minute baseline), returning both numeric minutes and human-readable format ('5 min read'). Use on blog card previews and article headers for UX transparency.
acceptanceCriteria: Function accepts markdown string and returns { minutes: number, formatted: string } (e.g., { minutes: 5, formatted: '5 min read' })
1000 words ≈ 5 min read; 2000 words ≈ 10 min read (based on 200 wpm; 1 word = ~5 chars including spaces)
Edge cases handled: empty string returns 1 min, code blocks/HTML tags are counted as text, result always ≥ 1 min
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/lib/reading-time.ts (calculateReadingTime(content: string): { minutes: number; formatted: string })
Test command: npm run test -- reading-time.test.ts (test: 100 chars, 1000 chars, 5000 chars, empty string, code blocks)

stories.title: Implement markdown excerpt extraction for blog post card previews
stories.description: Build extractExcerpt() utility that strips markdown syntax and returns first 150–160 characters for blog card displays. Handle code blocks, lists, and image syntax gracefully without breaking layout or leaving orphaned punctuation.
acceptanceCriteria: Removes markdown formatting (##, **, `code`, [link](url), ![image](url)) while preserving readability; returns plain text
Returns max 160 characters with '…' suffix if content exceeds limit; truncates at word boundary (no mid-word cuts)
Edge cases: code blocks and nested lists don't break output; multiple spaces/newlines collapsed to single space
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/lib/excerpt-generator.ts (extractExcerpt(markdown: string, charLimit: number = 160): string)
Test command: npm run test -- excerpt-generator.test.ts (test: plain text, headers, bold/italic, links, images, code blocks, truncation)

stories.title: Create BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schema for blog post navigation hierarchy
stories.description: Build generateBreadcrumbSchema() utility that generates breadcrumb structure (Home > Blog > [Category] > Post Title) in schema.org BreadcrumbList format. Integrate into blog [slug]/layout.tsx for proper navigation context in search results and Google rich snippets.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema includes @context: 'https://schema.org', @type: 'BreadcrumbList', itemListElement array with name, item (absolute URL), and position fields
Breadcrumb path: Home (/) > Blog (/blog) > Category (/blog?category=X) > Post Title (/blog/slug); all URLs are absolute with domain
Output validates against schema.org BreadcrumbList validator; position numbers start at 1 and increment by 1
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/lib/schema/breadcrumb-schema.ts (generateBreadcrumbSchema(slug: string, category: string, title: string, baseUrl: string))
